hypothesis: The radio entropy adapter copies bytes from the actual CE entropy service, refuses wrong-task and late-authority callers, and keeps its reservoir consistent under concurrency.
conclusion: The sanitizer run passed on the host. It establishes no random-source quality, physical CE behavior, native radio application execution or physical network operation.
narrative: Two host fixtures (checks/a733-radio-entropy.c with its runner a733-radio-entropy.py, and the contention fixture a733-radio-entropy-contention.c; all removed from the repository as superseded one-off compositions) reused existing CE model helpers with the actual entropy service, CE session, controller, clock registry and pool, without running the earlier CE test functions. Task identity, mutex dispatch, the counter, MMIO and DMA-produced bytes were explicit model inputs. The selected cases covered refill and circular-buffer consumption, copied and wrong-task refusal, output aliases, exhaustion, mutex contention, final-token contention, late authority loss and deadline retention, and checked that supplicant byte requests stop at the sequence reserve and that only the sequence hook drains it. The contention fixture (--fixture contention) ran no CE request: the owner thread placed a completed refill in staging and ran the actual adapter poll, which published it under the reservoir lock, while an IP-task thread consumed words concurrently. Every call had to copy a word or return a temporary refusal, the adapter must not fault, and the published bytes had to equal the copied bytes plus the remaining count. Single-threaded cases covered a held lock, the sequence reserve, wrong-task refusal and session fault. The runner preserved compiled input dependencies, the executable and native objects before one sanitizer execution, compiled the adapter against the actual single-core and cached eight-core task headers, and compiled the five direct native consumers of the session header once to cover atomic fault publication, with assertions preserving the prior field layout. The batch2 directory holds the successful sanitizer result, compiled source dependencies, executable and seven native objects. One earlier build stopped before execution because renaming the archived fixture's main removed its implicit return rule; the scoped diagnostic adjustment left those unexecuted cases unchanged. Existing CE protocol and network-stack evidence stayed separate and reusable.
